data.reason: You confirmed that your collector accepts clean glass bottles in this condition, so this one can go to Recycle. Follow the collector's requirements. A YOLO score doesn't prove that a facility will accept it.

source_details.scope_note: General material guidance. The type and cleanliness of an item don't guarantee that a local facility accepts it.
source_details.title: How Do I Recycle Common Recyclables

steps: Make sure the bottle really is glass and that your collector accepts it in this condition.
Empty it and rinse out ordinary residue as the collector asks. Stop if you suspect hazardous contamination.
Sort it by type and hand it over the way the collector asks. Don't cut or crush it unless they ask you to.
